prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one standalone 4:3 image for a visual guessing game.
Input image 1: edit target, yellow tracked excavator on a construction site.
Primary request: widen the framing to show the complete same excavator including its highest boom joint and pivot with at least 8% clear sky above, and the full bucket and tracks with surrounding margin. Preserve correct connected hydraulic boom, arm, bucket, cab and tracked chassis, yellow paint, natural light, and construction-site background. Vehicle should occupy about 75% of image height.
Constraints: no part of the vehicle cropped, no added equipment, text, logos, labels, watermark, tile cuts or borders.
